venue: ROGERS CENTRE (1 Blue Jays Way, Toronto, ON M5V 1J1, Canada). CONFIRMED CURRENT AND CORRECT BUILDING FOR THE 2026 SEASON. Step-0 checks performed. (1) The club's own site is live under the Rogers Centre name in 2026: 'Rogers Centre' with address '1 Blue Jays Way, Toronto, ON M5V 1J1, Canada' (https://www.mlb.com/bluejays/ballpark) and the ballpark A-Z guide is served at https://www.mlb.com/bluejays/ballpark/information/guide under the heading 'Rogers Centre'. (2) Wikipedia's 2026 Toronto Blue Jays season article gives the ballpark as 'Rogers Centre', city 'Toronto, Ontario', and describes 2026 as 'the Blue Jays' 35th full season (37th overall) at Rogers Centre' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Toronto_Blue_Jays_season). No relocation and no temporary host park for 2026 (contrast 2020-21, when the club played home games at Sahlen Field and TD Ballpark - that is over and is NOT relevant to 2026). (3) NAMING RIGHTS: the venue is named for Rogers Communications, which BOUGHT THE STADIUM OUTRIGHT in 2005 - this is an ownership rename, not a term-limited naming-rights deal, so there is no expiry to worry about. Wikipedia: the official name is 'Rogers Centre', adopted following Rogers Communications' 2005 purchase, and it remains 'commonly referred to as SkyDome in informal contexts among fans' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rogers_Centre). Ballparks of Baseball fact box: '-Former Name(s): SkyDome' / '-Naming Rights: Rogers Communications' (https://www.ballparksofbaseball.com/ballparks/rogers-centre/). (4) *** CRITICAL DISAMBIGUATION - DO NOT CONFUSE WITH 'ROGERS STADIUM' ***: 'Rogers Stadium' is a DIFFERENT, BRAND-NEW building - a temporary open-air concert venue at Downsview Park in north Toronto that opened in June 2025 and is Toronto's largest outdoor concert venue (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rogers_Stadium ; https://urbantoronto.ca/news/2025/06/rogers-stadium-opens-sunday-downsview-torontos-largest-outdoor-concert-venue.58877 ; https://www.ticketmaster.ca/rogers-stadium-tickets-toronto/venue/132627). Wikipedia even carries a disambiguation page for the name (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rogers_Stadium_(disambiguation)). The Blue Jays DO NOT play there. Any source, ticket listing or search result naming 'Rogers Stadium' in Toronto is a different venue. Both are Rogers-branded, both are in Toronto, and both host concerts - this is the highest-risk wrong-building trap for this park. (5) NO FIELD-vs-STADIUM naming split found: no separate field naming right (contrast the UNIQLO/Dodger Stadium case) was found for Rogers Centre. (6) STALE-SOURCE WARNING: the informal name 'SkyDome' (1989-2004) is still in wide fan use and appears in older writing; it is the SAME building.

capacity: CONFLICT - two live figures, both post-renovation, differing by which renovation phase they reflect. (1) 39,150 - Wikipedia infobox, given as the CURRENT figure after Phase 2: capacity history quoted verbatim as '1989-1998: 50,516', '1999-2022: 53,506', 'Post-Phase 1 (2023): 41,500', 'Post-Phase 2 (2024): 39,150' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rogers_Centre). (2) 41,500 - Ballparks of Baseball fact box: '-Capacity: 41,500 (current), 50,516 (past)'. Its own prose explains this is the PHASE-ONE number: upper-deck seats were replaced with 'wider, darker blue seating', 'reducing capacity to 41,500' (https://www.ballparksofbaseball.com/ballparks/rogers-centre/). Since Phase 2 (the complete demolition and rebuild of 'The entire lower-level seating structure') finished for the 2024 season, the Ballparks of Baseball 41,500 appears to be one phase STALE. (3) NO OFFICIAL CLUB FIGURE FOUND: neither https://www.mlb.com/bluejays/ballpark nor https://www.mlb.com/bluejays/ballpark/information/guide nor https://www.mlb.com/bluejays/ballpark/know-before-you-go states a seating capacity. RECOMMENDED: 39,150, flagged as not club-confirmed. DO NOT use 50,516 or 53,506 - those are pre-renovation.

orientation.batter_faces: NORTH. The batter at home plate faces north; centre field is to the NORTH, home plate to the SOUTH, RIGHT FIELD to the EAST, LEFT FIELD to the WEST. Consequently the FIRST-BASE side is the EAST side and is the SUNNY side, and the THIRD-BASE side is the WEST side and is the SHADE side; the sun sets behind left field. NOTE: Rogers Centre has a RETRACTABLE ROOF, so sun/shade only applies when the roof is open and roof panels shade parts of the bowl even then.
orientation.confidence: medium-high for the compass bearing (single explicit source, but internally consistent with the sun-path and shade statements on the same page and with independent RateYourSeats sun statements). No official Blue Jays or Wikipedia compass statement was found.
orientation.source: https://www.shadedseats.com/rogers-centre-shaded-seats/ - verbatim: 'Rogers Centre is one of the few major league parks where the batter faces north when hitting.' and 'the sun rotates from above home plate down the third base side of the park, eventually setting behind left field.' and 'This configuration generally makes the 3rd base side of the park the "shade side" and the 1st base side the "sunny side".' Same page, evening games: 'avoid sections 113-118, 210-218, 418-440, and 510-518' (i.e. the first-base-side sections take the late-day sun) and early-afternoon shaded sections '138-141, 102-105, 242-244, 204-206, 493-498, 401-408, 504-507, and 541-544'. ||| Independently corroborated in direction by RateYourSeats: 'Seating on the first base side of Rogers Centre is one of the most heavily exposed areas in the ballpark.' and 'One of the best places for shade at a Jays game is in the 200 level on the third base side of the field.' and 'Sections like 227-231 typically receive protection from the sun - even during day games.' and 'For the best views of the CN Tower from Rogers Centre, select seats on the third base side of the field.' (https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/100-level-infield ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating). WARNING: the shadedseats.com section numbers 504-507, 541-544 and 493-498 do NOT exist in the current RateYourSeats index (500 level runs 508-540), so that page is at least partly PRE-RENOVATION and its section numbers must not be trusted; its compass statement is used here only for the bearing.

numbering_direction.summary: *** SECTION NUMBERS INCREASE TOWARD THIRD BASE. *** LOW numbers = RIGHT FIELD and the FIRST-BASE side. HIGH numbers = THIRD-BASE side and LEFT FIELD. This is a SINGLE CONTINUOUS SWEEP around the bowl, one direction only. THERE IS NO PARITY / ODD-EVEN-OUTWARD SCHEME AT ROGERS CENTRE - nothing resembling the 'sections 111-115 on the first base side and 112-116 on the third base side' signature was found in any netting, zone, gate or elevator statement. Every numbered series runs the same way. PER-SERIES DETAIL: (a) 100 LEVEL (Field Level bowl + 100 Level Outfield), 101A-148B: 101-103 (A/B sub-sections) are the RIGHT-FIELD outfield seats beyond the wall; 104-113 wrap the right-field corner and the start of the first-base line (the 2025 Field Side Corner Club is 'Located in right field' and serves 'sections 110 to 113'); 116 is at FIRST BASE (the First Base Action Seats are at the front of Section 116); 122-126 are BEHIND HOME PLATE; 130-137 run down the THIRD-BASE line; 138-141 are the left-field corner; 142-148 (A/B sub-sections) are the LEFT-FIELD outfield seats beyond the wall, in front of / above the Blue Jays bullpen. (b) 200 LEVEL, 204-244: 204-206 at the right-field end, 210-218 on the first-base side, 221-227 the Home Plate Terrace directly behind home plate, 227-231 on the third-base side, 232-236 down the third-base line, 240-244 at the left-field end (the HR Zone is 'located in LF on the 200 level'). (c) 500 LEVEL, 508-540: 508 aligns with 100-level 108 (right-field corner - both are served by the SAME Gate 3 elevator), 510-518 on the first-base side, 522-526 the infield/home-plate arc, 539-540 at the left-field end (539 is served by the same Gate 13 elevator as 100-level 141). The 500 series is offset EXACTLY +400 from the 100 series: the club's own elevator table pairs 108/508, 121/521, 127/527 and 141/539. (d) FIELD LEVEL PREMIUM SERIES, 1-5 and 16-32 - A SEPARATE, SECOND SERIES that runs the SAME WAY: 16-22 (Blueprint Club) are on the FIRST-BASE side behind the VISITOR dugout, 21-22 closest to home plate; 23-25 are BEHIND HOME PLATE; 29-32 (Banner Club) are directly behind the BLUE JAYS dugout on the THIRD-BASE side. Sections 1-5 (TD Lounge) are a separate five-row strip directly behind home plate, sitting IN FRONT OF sections 23-28. SECTIONS 6-15 DO NOT APPEAR IN THE INDEX and their existence/position is UNKNOWN. The internal order of 1-5 (which end is toward first base) is UNKNOWN - no source states it.

anchors.section: BULLPEN CROSS-CHECK: visitor bullpen at 103 (RIGHT field) vs Blue Jays bullpen at 142-144 (LEFT field)
anchors.where: Geometry check independent of any 'first base / third base' wording. RateYourSeats 100 Level Outfield: 'Visitor bullpen: Near Sections 103 A & B' and 'Blue Jays bullpen: In front of Sections 142-144B'. Schneiders Porch (right field) is 'directly above the visitor bullpen'. The Catch Bar 'overlook[s] the RF bullpen'. Since the home bullpen is on the same side as the home dugout at this park (both third-base/left-field side), and the home dugout is on THIRD base, the LEFT-field end (142-148) is the third-base end - which is the HIGH-numbered end. Consistent with every other anchor.

numbering_direction.parity_check: NO PARITY SCHEME. Explicitly checked for the 'odd one way, even the other' signature described in the brief. Every range statement found at Rogers Centre is a CONTIGUOUS run that spans both parities - '101-103 (right field)', '142-148 (left field)', '110 to 113', '122-125', '221-227', '214-218', '232-236', '522-526', '16-22', '23-25', '29-32', '227-231', '210-218', '510-518', '113-118', '138-141', '204-206', '242-244'. None of them is odd-only or even-only. The park sweeps ONE WAY round the bowl. The only near-miss is the netting sentence 'The protective netting extends down the length of the first and third baseline walls, to Sections 113C & 130C, respectively' - that is a first-base endpoint and a third-base endpoint, NOT a parity pair, and both are odd. Use a single-sweep config, not a parity config.
numbering_direction.confidence: very high. Five independent source families agree and none dissents: (1) RateYourSeats zone pages (100 Level Outfield, 100 Level Infield, Field Level, 200 Level, 500 Level, TD Lounge, Banner Club, Blueprint Club, Schneiders Porch, WestJet Flight Deck) and per-section pages (101A, 105, 113, 116, 124, 126, 148B, 204, 244, 32, 508, 540); (2) the Blue Jays' own A-Z guide and Know Before You Go pages (elevator/gate table pairing 108/208/508, 121/221/521, 127/227/527, 141/240/539; Fan Services at 123 and 141; First Aid at 140/238/538; Infant Feeding Room at 240); (3) the official 2025 Field Side Corner Club press release ('Located in right field ... sections 110 to 113'); (4) Ballparks of Baseball ('-Home Dugout: Third Base'); (5) shadedseats.com sun geometry (batter faces north; first-base side sunny; 113-118 and 210-218 take the late sun). NO source anywhere places 101 in left field, 148 in right field, or the Blue Jays dugout on the first-base side.

RateYourSeats Field Level: 'Field Level seats at the Rogers Centre stretch across foul territory on the 100 Level' and 'Sections 108-141 in foul territory closest to the field'; 'Sections 1-5, 21-26, and 122-125 offer elite, centered views'; dugout seats are 'Blue Jays (29-32) and visitors (16-19) with Row 1 closest behind'; three premium clusters are listed as 'TD Lounge (Sections 1-5): Elite seats directly behind home plate', 'Banner Club (Sections 23-32): Premium access near the Jays dugout', 'Blueprint Club (Sections 16-22): Upscale seating with added comfort'. TD LOUNGE: 'TD Lounge Club seating includes Sections 1-5, located directly behind home plate and between the dugouts.' / 'Each section features just five rows, creating one of the most limited and exclusive seating environment[s]' / 'The TD Lounge Club seats are located directly in front of Sections 23-28'. BANNER CLUB: 'Sections 23-32 span from behind home plate to directly behind the Blue Jays dugout' / 'Sections 23-25: Behind home plate' / 'Sections 29-32: Directly behind the Blue Jays dugout' / 'All seats are located within 15 rows of the field'. Section 32: 'Rows in Section 32 are labeled 1-11'. BLUEPRINT CLUB: 'Sections 16-22 sit just behind the visitor dugout near home plate' / 'located just behind the visitor dugout on the first base side at Rogers Centre' / 'Sections 21 and 22 sit closer to home plate than any other Blueprint Club sections' / 'unique views into the visitor batting cage'. These clubs are the product of Phase 2 of the renovation: the Blue Jays' own press release describes 'three sold-out premium clubs beneath the seating bowl'. The club's premium entrance is 'TD Premium Entrance: near Gate 8'.

levels.name: 100 Level - Field Level bowl (foul territory), Sections 104-141
levels.notes: RateYourSeats Field Level: 'Sections 108-141 in foul territory closest to the field'; 'these seats benefit from improved sightlines, better angles toward the infield, and added comfort features' following the renovation. Row labelling is IRREGULAR section to section - observed verbatim: Section 105 'For most events, rows in Section 105 are labeled 1-12' with 'An entrance to this section is located at Row 12'; Section 113 'Rows in Section 113 are labeled 1-36, A' with 'An entrance to this section is located at Row A'; Section 116 'Rows 1-6, 7-40, 41D' with 'open space before Row 7' and 'an entrance located at Row 41D'; Section 124 'Rows in Section 124 are labeled 1-14, A' with an entrance at Row A; Section 126 'Rows in Section 126 are labeled 1-15, A' with 'An entrance to this section is located at Row A'. So the 100 level uses NUMBERED rows with an extra lettered row 'A' (and at least one 'D'-suffixed row, 41D) at the back near the concourse entrance. The First Base Action Seats are 'located at the front of Section 116'. The 2025 Field Side Corner Club serves the 'newly renovated right field seating bowl (sections 110 to 113)'.

levels.name: 100 Level Outfield ('Outfield District') - Sections 101-103 (right field) and 142-148 (left field)
levels.notes: Created in PHASE ONE of the renovation (completed for 2023). RateYourSeats 100 Level Outfield, verbatim: 'Sections 101-103 (right field)'; 'Sections 142-148 (left field)'; 'Most sections are divided into two parts: A Sections: Closest to the field with the best chance at catching home run balls' and 'B Sections: Located directly behind A, typically larger and holding more fans'; 'Visitor bullpen: Near Sections 103 A & B'; 'Blue Jays bullpen: In front of Sections 142-144B'. These are also 'the cheapest tickets on the 100 level' (Section 148B page). row_seat_conventions: ROWS ARE NUMBERED AT EVERY TIER, with a lettered back row at some 100-level sections. Observed verbatim from RateYourSeats section pages: FIELD LEVEL PREMIUM - TD Lounge: 'Each section features just five rows'; Banner Club: 'All seats are located within 15 rows of the field'; Section 32: 'Rows in Section 32 are labeled 1-11'. 100 LEVEL - Section 105: 'For most events, rows in Section 105 are labeled 1-12', entrance at Row 12; Section 113: 'Rows in Section 113 are labeled 1-36, A', entrance at Row A; Section 116: 'Rows 1-6, 7-40, 41D' with 'open space before Row 7' and entrance at Row 41D; Section 124: 'Rows in Section 124 are labeled 1-14, A', entrance at Row A; Section 126: 'Rows in Section 126 are labeled 1-15, A', entrance at Row A. So the 100-level convention is NUMBERED rows counting up from the field, with an extra lettered row 'A' (and at least one 'D'-suffixed row, 41D) at the back by the concourse entrance. 100 LEVEL OUTFIELD - Section 101A: 'Rows in Section 101A are labeled 1-2'; Section 148B: 'Rows in Section 148B are labeled 1-9', entrance at Row 9. 200 LEVEL - Section 204: 'Rows 1-7', entrance at Row 7; Section 244: 'Rows 1-11', entrance at Row 11; the page notes 'fewer than 15 rows typical of the 200 level'. 500 LEVEL - Section 508: 'Rows in Section 508 are labeled 1-28', entrance at Row 5; Section 540: 'Rows 1-13', entrance at Row 5. ACCESSIBLE LABEL CONVENTION - RateYourSeats states 'Accessible seats are typically labeled with a "W" prefix' and 'Accessible tickets are usually identified with a "W" prefix (e.g., W111)'. NOTE that this describes a SECTION prefix, not a row prefix, and the RateYourSeats section index does contain one entry rendered as 'W 11'. This is NOT club-confirmed and is listed in `uncertain`. UNKNOWN: no source states a per-tier row-count rule, and no source gives seats-per-row counts.
seat1_side_verbatim: PARK-WIDE BOILERPLATE ONLY - NO PER-SECTION Q&A FOUND. The only seat-numbering statement available is the RateYourSeats site-wide sentence, which appears identically on every Rogers Centre section page checked: *** 'When looking towards the field/ring/stage, lower number seats are on the right.' *** Verified verbatim on Sections 101A, 105, 113, 116, 124, 126, 148B, 204, 244, 32, 508 and 540 - i.e. on both the first-base side and the third-base side, in both outfield corners, behind home plate, and on all of the 100, 200 and 500 levels, plus the field-level premium series. IMPLICATION, given that section numbers increase toward third base: facing the field from any section, 'the right' points toward the LOWER-numbered neighbouring section, i.e. toward FIRST BASE / RIGHT FIELD. So SEAT 1 SITS ON THE FIRST-BASE-SIDE AISLE OF EACH SECTION, and seat numbers increase toward third base within a section - the same direction as the section numbers themselves. *** WARNING, PER THE BRIEF: this is the ticketing source's park-wide boilerplate, which at two other parks in this project was correct on one half of the ballpark and wrong on the other. NO per-section question-and-answer text stating seat 1's aisle was found anywhere for Rogers Centre, on RateYourSeats or on any official Blue Jays page, so the boilerplate CANNOT BE CHECKED against a per-section statement here. Treat the seat-1 rule as UNVERIFIED and lower-confidence than the section-numbering direction, which is very well attested. *** Sources: https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/126 ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/113 ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/124 ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/105 ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/148B ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/101A ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/204 ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/244 ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/508 ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/540 ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections/32
known_obstructions: NETTING (OFFICIAL, BUT SEE THE STALENESS WARNING): Toronto Blue Jays netting page, verbatim: 'The protective netting extends down the length of the first and third baseline walls, to Sections 113C & 130C, respectively, tapering off to the curve before the foul poles.' The same page states the netting 'reaches a height of 30 feet and matches the color and knotting of the netting previously installed behind home plate' and is 'designed to be visually unobtrusive'. (https://www.mlb.com/bluejays/ballpark/netting). *** STALENESS WARNING: the section identifiers '113C' and '130C' carry a 'C' suffix that does NOT exist anywhere in the current RateYourSeats section index (current 100-level suffixes are only A and B, and only in the outfield). This netting statement dates from the extended-netting programme announced in 2019 for the 2020 season, i.e. BEFORE the 2022-24 rebuild of the entire lower bowl. Its endpoints are also asymmetric against the current home-plate anchor (122-126): 113 is ~11 sections toward first base while 130 is only ~5 toward third. DO NOT treat 113C/130C as current section identifiers. No post-renovation netting statement was found. *** FAN-DATA NETTING (RateYourSeats, Section 126 page): 'Front of sections 117-126 are behind the netting' with varying coverage by section - this is consistent in kind but gives a different, narrower range and is fan-reported, not official. OVERHANG / ROOF: the 200-level overhang covers back rows ('200-Level rows under overhang' are shaded) and the retractable roof shades 'Center Field beneath non-retracted roof sections' (https://www.shadedseats.com/rogers-centre-shaded-seats/). BEHIND/SIDE STAGE (CONCERTS ONLY, NOT BASEBALL): Sections 101A, 105, 148B, 204, 244, 508 and 540 all carry 'Behind/Side Stage (most shows)' and the note that the section 'is behind the stage or to the side of the stage for most concerts. This may restrict or limit your view of the performance.' 500-LEVEL DISTANCE CAUTION: 'nearby sections (like 518 or 530) sit farther from the field than expected' (https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/500-level). CONCERT FLOOR: 'Because seating on the Field is flat, guests who purchase tickets in these sections run the risk of being blocked by guests in front of them.' (https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/field-seats). SECTION 116 GAP: 'Rows 1-6, 7-40, 41D' with 'open space before Row 7'. No source states any structural pillar or post obstruction at Rogers Centre.
uncertain: *** RENOVATION RENUMBERING - THE HEADLINE UNCERTAINTY. *** The 2022-24, ~$300 million two-phase renovation rebuilt the outfield (Phase 1, for 2023) and then demolished and rebuilt 'The entire lower-level seating structure' (Phase 2, for 2024). Wikipedia: Phase 1 = 're-orienting outfield seats to face home plate, raising bullpens, adjusting the outfield dimensions to be asymmetrical'; Phase 2 = 're-orienting the infield seats to face home plate' and 'reducing the size of foul territory, improving the dugouts'. THE SECTION NUMBERING DID CHANGE. Positive evidence: (a) an entirely new field-level premium series numbered 1-5 and 16-32 (TD Lounge / Blueprint Club / Banner Club) now exists and did not before; (b) the 100-level outfield now uses A/B sub-section suffixes (101A/101B ... 148A/148B); (c) the club's OWN netting page still uses 'C'-suffixed identifiers (113C, 130C) that exist nowhere in the current index. WHAT COULD NOT BE ESTABLISHED: no source anywhere gives an old-to-new section mapping, and no source states explicitly 'sections were renumbered'. TREAT ANY PRE-2023 ROGERS CENTRE SEATING SOURCE AS UNUSABLE FOR SECTION IDENTIFIERS. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rogers_Centre ; https://www.ballparksofbaseball.com/ballparks/rogers-centre/ ; https://www.mlb.com/bluejays/ballpark/netting ; https://www.rateyourseats.com/rogers-centre/seating/sections
